title: PUT /tournaments/:id/team response
description: The other arbiters with this tournament open right now, at a desk page or in the app, one entry per person (never this account). Memory only: gone with the tab, or 90 seconds after the phone's last heartbeat. Owner, editors and arbiters only; anyone else gets 404 tournament_not_found.

label.description: The name the others see: display name, or the address.

initials.description: One or two capital letters, or ?.

page.description: Where they are: the desk page (players, pairings, standings, settings...) or phone for the app.

round.description: The round they are looking at, if any.

entering_results.description: They saved a result in the last three minutes.

entering_here.description: They are entering results in the round named in the request. Warn the arbiter: two people on one round is where collisions come from.

heartbeat_seconds.description: How often to send the next heartbeat.
